metadata.case_name: ESPIRITU MARCELINO N AND ANOTHER v. LO KIT

injuries.description: 10 centimetre laceration of the vertex of his skull
source: Mr Espiritu suffered nonetheless a head injury involving a 10 centimetre laceration of the vertex of his skull and a 2 centimetre injury to his left cubital fossa when a metal rod entered the fleshy region of his elbow. There was a 2 centimetre cut over his right loin which also required sutures.

injuries.description: Injury to his left little finger (no permanent disability)
source: His physical injuries have by now resolved and the injury to his left little finger - potentially of some significance to a pianist - has not left any permanent disability.

manifestations.description: discomfort in his back, left side of his chest and occasional headache
minor anxiety disorder which has affected many aspects of his life
lack of confidence and consequent withdrawal from the musical scene

losses.description: Affected his confidence in his career as a musician, gave it up for a while and withdrawal from the musical scene making it more difficult to adjust to the economic downturn in the musical entertainment industry.
Minor anxiety disorder, lack of confidence and consequent withdrawal from the musical scene.
Acute stress disorder and over two years of anxiety suffered by Mrs Espiritu after seeing the hole in the balcony and hearing her husband's voice calling for help.
Loss of half her salary for the months in which she worked part-time to look after her husband and keep matters going at home (loss of earnings claimed and allowed).
